```{r}

# 1. Load the datasets
screen_time <- read.csv("C:/Users/frant/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Fall 26 Stat 112/ds112-portfolio-chrisfrantz10/pvj/PVJ spreadsheet Oct 18 - 24 - Sheet1.csv")

day_of_week_time <- read.csv("C:/Users/frant/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Fall 26 Stat 112/ds112-portfolio-chrisfrantz10/pvj/PVJ day of week data - Sheet1.csv")


#Standardize category names
screen_time_clean <- screen_time |>
  mutate(Category = recode(Category,
      "Productivity & Finance" = "Productivity_Finance",
      "Information & Reading" = "Info_Reading"))


#Convert day_of_week_time into long format
day_of_week_long <- day_of_week_time |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -Day_of_Week, names_to = "Category", values_to = "Time_Minutes") |>
  mutate(Day_of_Week = factor(Day_of_Week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat")))

#Calculate weekly screen time for each category
category_totals <- screen_time_clean |>
  filter(!is.na(Category)) |>
  group_by(Category) |>
  summarise(Weekly_Total = sum(Time_Minutes, na.rm = TRUE))

#Combine the datasets
combined_data <- day_of_week_long |>
  left_join(category_totals, by = "Category")

head(combined_data)

```

```{r}
# 6. Visualize screen time by day and category
combined_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Day_of_Week, y = Time_Minutes, color = Category, group = Category)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Screen Time by Day of the Week",
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Screen Time (Minutes)",
    color = "Category") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
combined_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Day_of_Week, y = Time_Minutes, color = Category, group = Category)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Screen Time by Day of the Week",
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Screen Time (Minutes)",
    color = "Category") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~ Category, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```


```{r}
# Keep all non-entertainment categories
other_categories <- day_of_week_long |>
  filter(Category != "Entertainment")

# Convert entertainment app data to a format compatible with the plot
entertainment_plot <- entertainment_long |>
  mutate(
    Category = Entertainment_App,
    Day_of_Week = factor("Week", levels = c(
      "Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat", "Week"
    ))
  )

# Combine the data
full_plot_data <- bind_rows(
  other_categories,
  entertainment_plot
)

# Plot
ggplot(full_plot_data,
       aes(x = Day_of_Week, y = Time_Minutes,
           color = Category, group = Category)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Screen Time by Day of the Week",
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Screen Time (Minutes)",
    color = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~Category, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

full_plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Day_of_Week, y = Time_Minutes, color = Category, group = Category)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Screen Time by Day of the Week",
    x = "Day of the Week",
    y = "Screen Time (Minutes)",
    color = "Category") +
  theme_minimal()
```
